troubleshooting.title: A page says no person is selected
troubleshooting.shortdesc: What to do when Family tree asks you to pick a person first, or Events and Notes show only the search box.

condition.p: You choose and the page says Pick a person, with a button named . You may see the same words on , or .

cause.p: These pages show one person at a time. You have not opened anyone yet, or you changed to another tree. There is no chip that starts with at the top.

step.cmd: Choose , or choose . Type a name in the search box, then choose .
Choose the card of the person you want.

stepresult.p: The chip that starts with shows their name. The page now works.
